# Introduction
This interactive dashboard lets you explore Cyclistic bike-share data with filters, tabs, and dynamic plots.

---

# Setup

```{r load_libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(shiny)
```


# Import Data

```{r import_data}
files <- list.files(pattern = "*.csv")
cyclistic_data <- files %>% map_df(~ read_csv(.x)) %>%
  mutate(
    started_at = ymd_hms(started_at),
    ended_at   = ymd_hms(ended_at),
    trip_duration_minutes = as.numeric(difftime(ended_at, started_at, units = "mins")),
    month = factor(month(started_at, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
                   levels = month.name, ordered = TRUE),
    day_of_week = wday(started_at, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
    season = case_when(
      month(started_at) %in% c(12,1,2) ~ "Winter",
      month(started_at) %in% c(3,4,5) ~ "Spring",
      month(started_at) %in% c(6,7,8) ~ "Summer",
      TRUE ~ "Fall"
    )
  )
```


# Dashboard

```{r dashboard, shiny=TRUE}
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Cyclistic Bike-Share Dashboard"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("member", "Choose Rider Type:",
                  choices = unique(cyclistic_data$member_casual)),
      sliderInput("duration", "Max Trip Duration (minutes):",
                  min = 5, max = 120, value = 60, step = 5)
    ),
    mainPanel(
      tabsetPanel(
        tabPanel("Overview",
                 plotOutput("riders_by_type"),
                 plotOutput("ride_length_dist")),
        tabPanel("Monthly Trends",
                 plotOutput("monthly_riders")),
        tabPanel("KPI Dashboard",
                 verbatimTextOutput("kpi_summary"))
      )
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  output$riders_by_type <- renderPlot({
    cyclistic_data %>%
      count(member_casual) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = member_casual, y = n, fill = member_casual)) +
      geom_col() +
      labs(title = "Riders by Member Type", y = "Number of Riders")
  })

  output$ride_length_dist <- renderPlot({
    cyclistic_data %>%
      filter(trip_duration_minutes <= input$duration) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = trip_duration_minutes, fill = member_casual)) +
      geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, position = "dodge") +
      labs(title = paste("Ride Length Distribution (<= ", input$duration, " mins)", sep=""),
           x = "Duration (minutes)", y = "Count")
  })

  output$monthly_riders <- renderPlot({
    cyclistic_data %>%
      filter(member_casual == input$member) %>%
      count(month) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = month, y = n)) +
      geom_line(size = 1.2, color = "steelblue") +
      geom_point() +
      labs(title = paste("Monthly Riders -", input$member),
           y = "Number of Riders")
  })

  output$kpi_summary <- renderPrint({
    total_rides <- nrow(cyclistic_data)
    avg_duration <- mean(cyclistic_data$trip_duration_minutes)
    peak_month <- cyclistic_data %>% count(month) %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% slice(1)
    member_split <- cyclistic_data %>% count(member_casual) %>% mutate(percentage = round(100 * n / sum(n), 2))

    list(
      Total_Rides = total_rides,
      Avg_Duration_Minutes = avg_duration,
      Peak_Month = peak_month,
      Member_vs_Casual = member_split
    )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
